title: The Weingarten map is a self-adjoint endomorphism of T_xM, and the Codazzi equations hold (frame-free form)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P a subspace with dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀ with IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M for every r ∈ ℕ, and let ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C^∞ on some open O ⊇ M, with ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x, for every x ∈ M. Let C(y) := Dν(y)∘P_y and, for x ∈ M and a ∈ T_x := tangentSpace M x, D_aC := fderivWithin ℝ C M x a. Then for x ∈ M and a, b, d ∈ T_x: (i) Dν(x)a ∈ T_x; (ii) Dν(x)a·b = Dν(x)b·a; (iii) (D_aC)(b)·d = (D_bC)(a)·d (Codazzi); (iv) (D_aC)(b)·d = (D_aC)(d)·b.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∀ a ∈ tangentSpace M x, ∀ b ∈ tangentSpace M x, fderiv ℝ ν x a ∈ tangentSpace M x ∧ inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ν x a) b = inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ ν x b) a ∧ ∀ d ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x a b) d = inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x b a) d ∧ inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x a b) d = inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x a d) b
